26259-her-mother-s-secret.title: A Novel
26259-her-mother-s-secret.creator: Mrs. E. D. E. N. Southworth
26259-her-mother-s-secret.description: A book by Mrs. E. D. E. N. Southworth. "'Honor,' mother dear? I do not see what honor has to do with it. Or if it has, I should think that honor would be better saved by my keeping faith with Le than by breaking with him! it will kill me!" moaned Odalite.

4624-off-hand-sketches-a-little-dashed-w.title: A little dashed with humour
4624-off-hand-sketches-a-little-dashed-w.creator: T. S. Arthur
4624-off-hand-sketches-a-little-dashed-w.description: A book by T. S. Arthur. Every year, he attends the annual conference of preachers, at which one of the bishops presides, and is liable to be assigned a new circuit, in the selection of which, as a general thing, he has no choice--the bishop making all the appointments; and so, term after term, he goes to a new place, among strangers.

62798-the-bombay-city-police-a-historica.creator: S. M. Edwardes, C.S.I., C.V.O.,
62798-the-bombay-city-police-a-historica.description: A book by S. M. Edwardes, C.S.I., C.V.O.,. A perusal of the official records of the early period of British rule in Bombay indicates that the credit of first establishing a force for the prevention of crime and the protection of the inhabitants belongs to Gerald Aungier, who was appointed Governor of the Island in 1669 and filled that office with conspicuous ability until his death at Surat in 1677.

arxiv-2111-14610.title: Orbit-localised thermosphere density prediction using a Kalman filter based calibration of empirical models Journal: Acta Astronautica
arxiv-2111-14610.creator: George Bowden
arxiv-2111-14610.description: Abstract Accurate estimation of thermosphere mass density is critical to determining how satellite orbits evolve over time and thus to planning and managing space missions. Empirical thermosphere models are commonly employed for this purpose, but have substantial uncertainties. In this work, a Kalman filter method for calibrating these models along a particular satellite’s trajectory is described.

arxiv-2209-02055.title: Full Kullback-Leibler-Divergence Loss for Hyperparameter-free Label Distribution Learning
arxiv-2209-02055.creator: Maurice Günder, Nico Piatkowski, Christian Bauckhage
arxiv-2209-02055.description: Abstract The concept of Label Distribution Learning (LDL) is a technique to stabilize classification and regression problems with ambiguous and/or imbalanced labels. A prototypical use-case of LDL is human age estimation based on profile images. Regarding this regression problem, a so called Deep Label Distribution Learning (DLDL) method has been developed.

arxiv-2306-01038.title: Clouds accreting from the IGM are not able to feed the star formation of low-redshift disc galaxies 2023 Clouds accreting from the IGM are not able to feed the star formation of low-redshift disc galaxies – References
arxiv-2306-01038.creator: Andrea Afruni, Gabriele Pezzulli, Filippo Fraternali, & Asger Grønnow
arxiv-2306-01038.description: Abstract Galactic halos accrete material from the intergalactic medium (IGM) and part of this accretion is expected to be in the form of cool ( T ∼ 10 4 T\sim 10^{4} K) gas. A signature of this process could reside in the detection of numerous clouds in the circumgalactic medium (CGM).

arxiv-2404-02849.creator: Adam M. Krajewski, Jonathan W. Siegel, Zi-Kui Liu a. Department of Materials Science and Engineering, The Pennsylvania State University, USAb. Department of Mathematics, Texas A&M University, USACorresponding Author: A. M. Krajewski, adam@phaseslab.org | ak@psu.edu

The triangle singularity is found to play a significant role in the process, resulting in the creation of a resonance-like structure around 1.

arxiv-2501-10200.title: Test Wars: A Comparative Study of SBST, Symbolic Execution, and LLM-Based Approaches to Unit Test Generation
arxiv-2501-10200.creator: 1 st Azat Abdullin, 2 nd Pouria Derakhshanfar, 3 rd Annibale Panichella
arxiv-2501-10200.description: Abstract Generating tests automatically is a key and ongoing area of focus in software engineering research. The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has opened up new opportunities, given their ability to perform a wide spectrum of tasks. However, the effectiveness of LLM-based approaches compared to traditional techniques such as search-based software testing (SBST) and symbolic execution remains uncertain.

arxiv-2506-22321.title: A Practical Approach to Power Saving in Hearables Using Sub-Nyquist Sampling with Bandwidth Extension DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: IMWUT Volume: 0 0 0 0 CCS: Human-centered computing Ubiquitous and mobile computing systems and tools
arxiv-2506-22321.creator: Tarikul Islam Tamiti, Anomadarshi Barua
arxiv-2506-22321.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tarikul Islam Tamiti, Anomadarshi Barua. Hearables are wearable computers that are worn on the ear. Bone conduction microphones (BCMs) are used with air conduction microphones (ACMs) in hearables as a supporting modality for multimodal speech enhancement (SE) in noisy conditions.

arxiv-2512-08443.title: Fully Decentralized Certified Unlearning
arxiv-2512-08443.creator: Hithem Lamri, Michail Maniatakos
arxiv-2512-08443.description: Abstract Machine unlearning (MU) seeks to remove the influence of specified data from a trained model in response to privacy requests or data poisoning. While certified unlearning has been analyzed in centralized and server-orchestrated federated settings (via guarantees analogous to differential privacy, DP), the decentralized setting—where peers communicate without a coordinator—remains underexplored.

arxiv-2601-14269.title: The Slow Drift of Support: Boundary Failures in Multi-Turn Mental Health LLM Dialogues
arxiv-2601-14269.creator: Youyou Cheng, MSc, Zhuangwei Kang, PhD, Kerry Jiang, MSc, Chenyu Sun, MD, MSc, Qiyang Pan, MD
arxiv-2601-14269.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have been widely used for mental health support. However, current safety evaluations in this field are mostly limited to detecting whether LLMs output prohibited words in single-turn conversations, neglecting the gradual erosion of safety boundaries in long dialogues. Examples include making definitive guarantees, assuming responsibility, and playing professional roles.

pmc-10734333.title: Dairy and gluten in disease activity in multiple sclerosis
pmc-10734333.creator: Isabel A Temperley, Alexandra N Seldon, Madeline AW Reckord, Claudia A Yarad, Farihah T Islam, Kerith Duncanson, Rodney A Lea, Jeannette Lechner-Scott, Vicki E Maltby
pmc-10734333.description: BackgroundMany diets promoted specifically for multiple sclerosis have been suggested to improve disease activity. Dairy and gluten are two components for which the recommendations vary between these diets. Existing research into the association between these dietary components and disease activity has been conflicting.

pmc-11575409.title: Associations of baseline and changes in the triglyceride glucose-weight adjusted waist index and cardiovascular disease risk: evidence from middle-aged and older individuals
pmc-11575409.creator: Chenglin Duan, Meng Lyu, Jingjing Shi, Xintian Shou, Lu Zhao, Yuanhui Hu
pmc-11575409.description: BackgroundExisting researches have predominantly focused on the implications of dynamic alterations in the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and traditional obesity measures for cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk. However, the application of the weight-adjusted waist index (WWI), which incorporates the dynamically changing body composition factors of weight and waist circumference, alongside the TyG index for predicting CVD risk, remains unexplored.

pmc-11592705.title: Quantum Information Scrambling in Adiabatically Driven Critical Systems
pmc-11592705.creator: Ricardo Puebla, Fernando J. Gómez-Ruiz
pmc-11592705.description: Quantum information scrambling refers to the spread of the initially stored information over many degrees of freedom of a quantum many-body system. Information scrambling is intimately linked to the thermalization of isolated quantum many-body systems, and has been typically studied in a sudden quench scenario.

pmc-12230277.title: Physiotherapy for the Management of Polymyalgia Rheumatica: Results From a UK Cross‐Sectional Survey
pmc-12230277.creator: Anne V. O'Brien, Sara Muller, Jennifer Liddle, Martin J. Thomas, Christian D. Mallen
pmc-12230277.description: IntroductionPolymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) international management guidelines advocate patient education and individualised exercises but lack evidence and physiotherapy practice for PMR is unknown. PMR is typically treated with glucocorticoids, but side effects are frequent and concerning to patients. This study investigated UK physiotherapy practice in PMR.

pmc-12511211.title: Hypophosphatasia and Type 1 Diabetes: A Pilot Study and Review of Literature
pmc-12511211.creator: Zunera Tariq, Jake P. Tinsley, Dana Carpenter, Janet K. Snell-Bergeon, Viral N. Shah
pmc-12511211.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Purpose of ReviewHypophosphatasia (HPP) and type 1 diabetes (T1D) are both associated with low bone turnover and increased fracture risk. In this review, our objectives were to (a) discuss results of our pilot study aimed to evaluate prevalence and clinical and radiological characteristics of HPP in adults with T1D and (b) to review literature on the use of electronic medical records (EMR) for HPP case findings.Recent FindingsIn our pilot study, 18 individuals had persistent low alkaline phosphatase levels (ALP) [18/1723, 1.05%].

pmc-13096634.title: Hybrid Aquila optimizer–Harris Hawks optimization for CNN hyperparameter tuning in brain tumor classification
pmc-13096634.creator: Manoj Kumar, Noor Mohd, G Shivam, Ankur Goyal, Deepak Parashar, Rijwan Khan
pmc-13096634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is hard to categorize properly in terms of interclass similarity, there is data imbalance, and sensitive clinical decision-making: but the performance of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) highly relies on effective, yet computationally costly, hyperparameter tuning.

pmc-13145211.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1918 DIAGNOSTIC VALUE AND RELATED MECHANISMS OF PLASMA EXOSOMAL LNCRNAS IN STROKE
pmc-13145211.creator: Jiangmin Li
pmc-13145211.description: Background and aimsAcute ischemic stroke (AIS) and hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage (HICH) are neurological diseases with high incidence and disability rates. Current therapeutic approaches remain limited, and there is an urgent clinical need for highly specific, convenient, and efficient biomarkers as well as novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.MethodsThe study first collected plasma samples from AIS patients, HICH patients, and healthy controls.

pmc-13207955.title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Spatial Analyses Associate M2-like Myeloid Signatures with Neuroimmune Remodeling in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-13207955.creator: Sz-Bo Wang, Kuan-Nien Chou, Yi-Lin Chiu
pmc-13207955.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is characterized by progressive neurodegeneration and prominent neuroimmune remodeling, but the contribution of macrophage and myeloid states across disease severity remains incompletely defined. We integrated bulk transcriptomic, single-cell RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize AD-associated myeloid immune changes across Braak stage and disease status.

pmc-13287191.title: Real-World Evidence for Drug Value Assessment in China: Learning from International Experiences
pmc-13287191.creator: Abraham G. Hartzema, Adel Gehchan, Jennifer D. Guo, Jianwei Xuan
pmc-13287191.description: In China, the national medical insurance system has undergone rapid development over the past two decades. The National Healthcare Security Administration was established to manage the growing healthcare expenditure. Since then, this administration has maintained the drug formulary, known as the National Reimbursement Drug List.

pmc-13298546.title: Healthcare-associated infections and antimicrobial resistance in Canadian acute care hospitals, 2020–2024
pmc-13298546.creator: Canadian Nosocomial Infection Surveillance Program
pmc-13298546.description: BackgroundHealthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) continue to contribute to excess morbidity and mortality among Canadians.ObjectiveTo describe epidemiologic and laboratory characteristics and trends of HAIs and AMR, 2020–2024, using surveillance and laboratory data submitted by hospitals to the Canadian Nosocomial Infection Surveillance Program (CNISP) and by provincial and territorial laboratories to the National Microbiology Laboratory.

pmc-13385091.title: Role of the inferior frontal gyrus and impulsivity in approach motivation: A low-frequency repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation study
pmc-13385091.creator: Austin T Moran, Timothy McCoy, Hilmar Zech, Philip A Gable
pmc-13385091.description: Human actions are motivated by drives to approach positive outcomes or avoid adverse outcomes. Neurophysiological studies have associated the right-lateralized inferior frontal gyrus (IFG) with the regulation of approach motivation and individual differences in impulsivity, particularly in relation to deficits in motivational regulation. These studies suggest that the right IFG may inhibit approach-motivational tendencies.

pmc-13435721.title: Fournier Gangrene in an Immunocompetent Woman Following Minor Perineal Manipulation: A Case Report
pmc-13435721.creator: Ali Bassi, Futoon Alsaleh
pmc-13435721.description: Patient: Female, 40-year-old Final Diagnosis: Fournier’s gangrene Symptoms: Left labial pain and swelling extending to the suprapubic region, associated with vomiting and lower abdominal pain Clinical Procedure: — Specialty: Obstetrics and Gynecology Objective: Rare disease BackgroundFournier gangrene is a rare, life-threatening necrotizing fasciitis involving the perineum and external genitalia.

pmc-13610740.title: Multilevel Analysis of Glutathione-Induced Responses in Pepper Seedlings Under Water-Deficit Conditions
pmc-13610740.creator: Melek Ekinci, Esma Yigider, Metin Turan, Selda Ors, Murat Aydin, Ertan Yildirim
pmc-13610740.description: Drought stress is a major abiotic factor that negatively affects plant growth, physiological processes, and yield in pepper cultivation. This study evaluated the ameliorative effects of exogenous glutathione (GSH) at 50 µM and 100 µM in pepper seedlings grown under water-restricted conditions (60% field capacity), using morphological, physiological, and biochemical parameters.

pmc-13617154.title: The role of reading and writing history, education, and socioeconomic status on word and pseudoword naming in adult readers of Brazilian Portuguese
pmc-13617154.creator: Letícia Priscila Pacheco, Lilian Cristine Hübner, Maximiliano Agustin Wilson
pmc-13617154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMultiple factors contribute to cognitive maintenance and the development of cognitive reserve in aging, including life experiences and behaviors. Among these, education plays a key role, particularly through language-related activities such as reading and writing.ObjectiveThis study investigates the impact of Reading and Writing Habits (RWH), alongside educational level and socioeconomic status (SES), on word and pseudoword naming across the lifespan in Brazilian Portuguese.MethodsUsing a stepwise linear regression model, we analyzed the predictive value of age, SES, education, and RWH on naming performance
